raw: [{"bbox": [85, 74, 582, 90], "category": "Page-header", "text": "KHANG DIEN HOUSE TRADING AND INVESTMENT JOINT STOCK COMPANY"}, {"bbox": [561, 98, 686, 113], "category": "Page-header", "text": "Form B 09 - DN/HN"}, {"bbox": [85, 128, 554, 145], "category": "Section-header", "text": "## 2 SUMMARY OF SIGNIFICANT ACCOUNTING POLICIES (continued)"}, {"bbox": [85, 159, 265, 176], "category": "Section-header", "text": "### 2.20 Revenue recognition"}, {"bbox": [85, 190, 345, 206], "category": "Section-header", "text": "#### (a) Revenue from sales of properties"}, {"bbox": [129, 219, 687, 266], "category": "Text", "text": "Revenue from sales of properties is recognised in the consolidated income statement when the real estate is completed and ready for transfer to customers, and when all five (5) of the following conditions are satisfied:"}, {"bbox": [129, 279, 688, 310], "category": "List-item", "text": "* The Group has transferred to the buyer the significant risks and rewards of ownership of the real estate asset;"}, {"bbox": [129, 310, 687, 340], "category": "List-item", "text": "* The Group no longer holds the right to manage the real estate asset as the real estate's owner nor the right to control the real estate asset;"}, {"bbox": [129, 340, 452, 355], "category": "List-item", "text": "* The amount of revenue can be measured reliably;"}, {"bbox": [129, 355, 687, 385], "category": "List-item", "text": "* The Group has received or entitled to receive economic benefits from the sale of the real estate asset; and"}, {"bbox": [129, 385, 687, 416], "category": "List-item", "text": "* The costs incurred or to be incurred in respect of the real estate asset can be measured reliably."}, {"bbox": [129, 429, 687, 460], "category": "Text", "text": "No revenue is recognised if there are significant uncertainties regarding recovery of the consideration due or the possible return of goods."}, {"bbox": [129, 474, 687, 549], "category": "Text", "text": "Revenue is recognised in accordance with the \"substance over form\" principle and allocated to each sale obligation. If the Group gives promotional goods to customers associated with their purchases, the Group allocates the total considerations received between goods sold and promotional goods. The cost of promotional goods is recognised as cost of goods sold in the consolidated income statement."}, {"bbox": [85, 564, 361, 581], "category": "Section-header", "text": "#### (b) Revenue from rendering of services"}, {"bbox": [129, 594, 687, 669], "category": "Text", "text": "Revenue from rendering of services is recognised in the consolidated income statement when the services are rendered, by reference to completion of the specific transaction assessed on the basis of the actual service provided as a proportion of the total services to be provided. Revenue from rendering of services is only recognised when all four (4) of the following conditions are satisfied:"}, {"bbox": [129, 683, 452, 699], "category": "List-item", "text": "* The amount of revenue can be measured reliably;"}, {"bbox": [129, 699, 687, 730], "category": "List-item", "text": "* It is probable that the economic benefits associated with the transaction will flow to the Group;"}, {"bbox": [129, 730, 687, 760], "category": "List-item", "text": "* The percentage of completion of the transaction at the consolidated balance sheet date can be measured reliably; and"}, {"bbox": [129, 760, 687, 790], "category": "List-item", "text": "* The costs incurred for the transaction and the costs to complete the transaction can be measured reliably."}, {"bbox": [85, 804, 231, 820], "category": "Section-header", "text": "#### (c) Interest income"}, {"bbox": [129, 834, 687, 865], "category": "Text", "text": "Interest income is recognised in the consolidated income statement on the basis of the actual time and interest rates for each period when both (2) of the following conditions are satisfied:"}, {"bbox": [149, 878, 687, 909], "category": "List-item", "text": "* It is probable that economic benefits associated with the transaction will flow to the Company; and"}, {"bbox": [149, 909, 376, 924], "category": "List-item", "text": "* Income can be measured reliably."}, {"bbox": [378, 985, 392, 998], "category": "Page-footer", "text": "21"}]
